verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships a CLI, SDKs and AI tooling, so opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection or any opt-out control. Scoped API keys and the sandbox are adjacent security features, not telemetry controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
